messages:
kevin (oncall): saw a brief spike of 502s for traffic us-east -> ap-south at 10:20 UTC, opening a thread to triage.
alex (eng-net): edge-dns logs show a burst of SERVFAILs starting 10:19:40 after the new limiter went live in ap-south. large number of LB retries stacked.
maria (sre): tracing confirms retries 2-4x before fallback; customer error impact ~1.9% over ~5m window.
jenny (netops): that was the 'dns-safe-mode' rollout at 10:15 to tighten noisy clients. we pushed tighter steady qps and a small burst.
kevin (oncall): can we revert or widen burst quickly?
jenny (netops): widening burst + restoring previous steady qps for ap-south now, will monitor.
deploy-bot: config-change 2026-12-05T10:23Z applied by netops: dns-safe-mode patched (ap-south)
alex (eng-net): follow-ups: 1) exempt verified healthcheck CIDRs from limiter, 2) increase LB service TTLs to 60s, 3) add staging canary for limiter changes, 4) automated sim for healthcheck bursts.
maria (sre): creating retro ticket INF-4999, will attach logs/graphs and tag owners (alex, jenny). proposing retro next Tuesday.
kevin (oncall): mitigated at ~10:25 UTC after the burst tweak. please add owners/ETAs to INF-4999 and schedule the limiter review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
